CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW [EDS].[MV2_GENDER]
AS SELECT BANK_ID
,CATEGORYID
,CATEGORYTYPE
,[VALUE]
,DESCRIPTION
,DEL_FLG
,SCD_Start_Date
,SCD_End_Date
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES
WHERE CATEGORYTYPE = 'GENDER' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01';
GO


CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW EDS.MV2_GENDER
WITH (DISTRIBUTION  = ROUND_ROBIN  )
AS
 
SELECT BANK_ID
,CATEGORYID
,CATEGORYTYPE
,[VALUE]
,DESCRIPTION
,DEL_FLG
,SCD_Start_Date
,SCD_End_Date
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
FROM EDS.CRM_CATEGORIES_TEST
WHERE CATEGORYTYPE = 'GENDER' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
